mcqs.question: A dendritic ulcer staining positively with fluorescein dye on the cornea is pathognomonic of infection by:
mcqs.explanation: HSV-1 keratitis classically produces branching dendritic epithelial ulcers with terminal bulbs that stain bright green with fluorescein.
